lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the CRITICAL Dockerfile bug: oven/bun:1.2-slim ships only bun (no Node.js or npm). Added nodejs and npm to the apt-get install line alongside git, and corrected the incorrect comment 'bun and node are provided by the base image' to 'oven/bun:1.2-slim ships only bun; Node.js is not included'. The RUN npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.197 line is now valid. Next story US-R1-002 needs to add sudo and firewall tooling (iptables, ipset, dnsutils, curl) to the apt-get install and grant the bun user passwordless sudo, so init-firewall.sh can actually run at container start.

officialDocsValidated.summary: oven/bun:1.2-slim ships only the bun runtime (no Node.js, no npm). Confirmed by reviewer finding and imbios/bun-node existing specifically to bundle bun+node. Fix (apt-get install nodejs npm) is correct.
